Lending adjusted net revenue reached approximately $807.4 million , while Lending products increased 39% year-over-year to 3.4 million, and credit performance remained strong and in line with expectations. Personal Loan products reached approximately 2.6 million, Student Loan products reached approximately 760,000 and Home Loan products reached approximately 72,000. Lending adjusted revenue per product increased to approximately $942, compared with approximately $920 in the second quarter of 2026 and $782 in the third quarter of 2025. • Driving Financial Services Revenue Through Product Growth and Monetization. Financial Services revenue increased 25% year-over-year to approximately $525.1 million , while products grew 44% to 23.2 million. Money and Relay drove the greatest absolute growth, each surpassing 8 million products and increasing 34% and 45%, respectively. Invest grew 37% to more than 4 million products, while Credit Card grew 67% to approximately 656,000 products, with a high percentage of primary card users and strong credit performance. Annualized Financial Services revenue per product increased to approximately $90 in the third quarter from $88 in the second quarter of 2026, reflecting continued monetization through deposits, spending, brokerage, lending referrals, subscriptions, credit card balances and other fee-based services. • Setting Bold Ambitions for 2030. SoFi now has eight businesses that each generated over $100 million in annualized revenue. By 2030, the Company plans on reaching 100 million products and scaling five businesses to more than $1 billion in revenue, five businesses to more than $500 million in revenue and five businesses to more than $100 million in revenue. This reflects SoFi's strategy to evolve from a single-product student loan refinancing business in 2018 to an everything financial app serving 17.1 million members today.
